services.name: School Programs
services.desc: For over 30 years, the Museum has delivered education programs that are accessible, exciting, and curriculum-connected. With a modern museum building, an 1859 schoolhouse, and an 1815 Mennonite family home, the Lincoln Museum and Cultural Centre offers truly unique educational experiences. Here, students can discover, learn, and explore. Make the most of your visit by having classes experience different programs at the same time. While one class steps into the Strict but Nice 1908 classroom, another can explore history through the Reading the Landscape or Hands-On History experience. To book, visit our online booking portal. All inquiries will be answered within 2 standard business days.
